decisions.decision: Spider chart layout: 1×3 horizontal grid, 340×340 square per chart, autosize+responsive
decisions.rationale: Visual parity with Phase 8 top-N table (3 columns); square preserves polar geometry; autosize handles narrow viewports.

decisions.decision: Heuristic axes distinguished by (heuristic) suffix + #666 tickfont (vs #222 for measured)
decisions.rationale: Plotly scatterpolar lacks per-tick gridcolor — dual-signal (label suffix + muted tickfont) communicates uncertainty without breaking polar geometry. WCAG AA: #666 at 11px+ passes.

decisions.decision: Pareto-front overlay IN SCOPE this phase (POLAR-05)
decisions.rationale: Pareto-optimal cells over (composite_score↑, image_size_mb↓) get a ★ U+2605 glyph in the table. macOS host excluded (no Docker image). Includes unit tests for Pareto-frontier calculation.
tinytemplate doesn't render serde_json::Value directly; pre-serialize to String for template context. Avoids designing a typed Plotly trace API.

decisions.rationale: Honors D-02 static file:// discipline. Safety gate via html::tests::plotly_sri_hash_unchanged sentinel test.
